description: projects selected CSV columns in caller order using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded csv select columns result before an agent hands structured data or a batch plan to a downstream tool with a stricter contract. Returns the bounded transformation or validation finding with counts, normalized values, and a versioned result contract for CSV Select Columns as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Processes bounded caller-supplied data in memory only; it performs no file fetch, database write, code execution, or retention.

columns.description: Columns supplied to CSV Select Columns; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

text.description: Text supplied to CSV Select Columns; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.
